rule.name: ConfigurationReadOutsideCompositionRoot
rule.message: Read environment variables and system properties once in the composition root (the class with main, a Guice or Dagger module, a CDI or Micronaut factory) or through the typed configuration of the framework, and pass the values in through constructors or parameters, not System.getenv, System.getProperty, Integer.getInteger, Long.getLong or Boolean.getBoolean. JVM properties such as java.*, user.*, javax.*, jdk.* and http.* are fine. A library reading its own opt-in switch (-Dmylib.debug) takes an exception.

property.name: xpath
property.value: ( //MethodCall [pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.System#getenv(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.System#getProperty(_*)')] [ArgumentList/* or parent::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('get', 'getOrDefault', 'containsKey')]] | //MethodCall [pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.Integer#getInteger(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.Long#getLong(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.Boolean#getBoolean(_*)')] | //MethodReference [@MethodName = ('getenv', 'getProperty') and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.System')] or @MethodName = 'getInteger' and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Integer')] or @MethodName = 'getLong' and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Long')] or @MethodName = 'getBoolean' and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Boolean')]] ) [not(ArgumentList/*[1][self::StringLiteral] [matches(@ConstValue, '^(java|user|os|file|line|path|javax|jdk|sun|com\.sun|http|https|ftp)\.|^socks')])] [not(ancestor::CompilationUnit//MethodDeclaration[@Name = 'main'][VoidType] [count(FormalParameters/FormalParameter) <= 1])] [not(ancestor::*/ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.AutoConfiguration') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.test.context.TestConfiguration') or pmd-java:typeIs('io.micronaut.context.annotation.Factory') or pmd-java:typeIs('io.micronaut.context.annotation.ConfigurationProperties') or pmd-java:typeIs('io.quarkus.runtime.annotations.QuarkusMain') or pmd-java:typeIs('dagger.Module') or pmd-java:typeIs('dagger.Provides') or pmd-java:typeIs('com.google.inject.Provides') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.enterprise.inject.Produces') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.enterprise.inject.Produces')])] [not(ancestor::ClassDeclaration/*[self::ExtendsList or self::ImplementsList]/ClassType[ pmd-java:typeIs('com.google.inject.AbstractModule') or pmd-java:typeIs('com.google.inject.Module') or pmd-java:typeIs('io.quarkus.runtime.QuarkusApplication') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.env.EnvironmentPostProcessor') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.ApplicationContextInitializer')])]
